newsitem.title: JAPAN: British Petro to enter Japan gasoline mart-source.
newsitem.headline: British Petro to enter Japan gasoline mart-source.

text.p: Oil giant British Petroleum Co Plc will enter Japan's highly competitive gasoline retail market in conjunction with a small Japanese supermarket chain, a source from the venture said on Wednesday.
BP plans to start opening service stations in central Japan by the end of this year, the source said.

A spokesman with Japanese supermarket chain operator Beisia Co Ltd said it had reached a broad agreement with BP for the British oil company to open a petrol station at one of its shopping malls before the end of this year.
He said they planned to sign a contract around the middle of next month.
The spokesman said the companies were aiming to launch another five or six BP service stations by the end of 1998.
"We've agreed on the (details) of the first outlet such as the location...and that we should open another five or six by the end of next year," he said.
BP, which will be leasing the land as a tenant, will be responsible for the management of the petrol station, the spokesman said.
